system.description:
You expertly weave a net creating an impregnable barrier using your adamantine sealing chains. The barrier appears at a point you can see within range. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You form it into a sphere with a 15-foot radius. It lasts for the duration.

If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears the creature is pushed to a side of the wall of your choice (Inside or outside). If a hostile creature attempts to move through the barrier or target a creature inside the barrier without the caster’s permission, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot move through the barrier or target creatures within the barrier for the remainder of the turn and must choose a new valid target. Jutsu or abilities that affect an area penetrate and move through the barrier as if it wasn’t there.

| 5-Pronged Seal / [Physical], [Mental], [Sensory] / You have the legendary 5-Pronged Seal, etched onto you. For the next hour, this seal binds your power significantly, inflicting the following effects. / Increase the cost of Jutsu by +10. / Reduce the damage you deal by -8 / Reduce the number of Jutsu you can concentrate on by -1. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 20 Ninshou check to remove this condition. On a failure, the DC increases by +5. / Once you end this condition, you cannot gain it again for 1 Day |

Seal Break. If a creature within 30 feet of you have ranks of Sealed, you can dispel one rank of that creatures Sealed condition to grant the barrier a number of temporary hit points equal to the rank this jutsu was cast at. (D-Rank: 10, C-Rank: 16, B-Rank: 22, A-Rank: 28, S-Rank: 34). Damaging effects that would affect creature(s) within the barrier, instead affect the barrier. If the barriers temporary hit points are reduced to 0, all remaining damage is applied to their intended targets, following normal attack roll or saving throw procedure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
